$comment: Shared design tokens. Source of truth for iPhone (ios/Design/Tokens.swift), desktop/web (tokens.css) and the website. Spec for every part: design-system.md.
name: Ruben on Mission · brutal

accentFor.$comment: Which accent a section, area or collection uses, so a thing has the same colour on both apps.

shadow.$comment: Hard offset shadow: a solid ink shape behind, never a blur. Pressed buttons move by the offset and lose the shadow.

font.$comment: Familjen Grotesk is the website font (website/fonts). Fall back to the platform's bold sans.

components.tileCard: Folder-tab card: an accent-coloured tab on top-left with the title, paper body, ink outline, hard shadow. Holds an icon square (accent fill, ink outline) and a big count.
components.iconButton: Square, paper fill, ink outline, small hard shadow, ink icon.
components.primaryButton: Yellow fill, ink outline, hard shadow, bold label. Pressed: moves by the shadow offset, shadow gone.
components.addButton: Big round or square yellow + button, ink outline and hard shadow.
components.chip: Pill, accent fill at full strength, ink outline (thin), bold caption text.
components.folderCard: Paper body (top-left radius 0) with a slanted accent tab carrying the title; see folderTab and design-system.md §4.
components.floatingTabBar: Paper pill, radius 22, outline + hard shadow, 16 from the sides and 8 above the safe area; selected item gets an accent rounded fill.
components.toggle: 52x30 pill track (paper off, green on), 22 paper knob with outline and 2pt hard shadow.
components.segmented: Outlined box split by ink lines; selected segment accent-filled.
components.select: Text-field look with a bold chevron-down; opens the system menu.
components.dateField: Select look with a calendar icon, shows 'Fri 9 Oct'; x clears optional dates.
components.stepper: Two compact icon buttons (- +) around a bold monospaced number.
components.searchField: Text field with magnifier and clear button, pinned under the title.
components.formSection: Bold header, card holding rows split by hairline lines, muted footer.
components.spinner: 20pt yellow outlined square rotating in 90-degree steps.
components.dialog: Centred paper card on 40% ink scrim; stacked full-width buttons.
components.sheet: Cream, top radius 16, ink top outline and grab handle; Cancel/Save as compact buttons.
components.toast: Small paper box above the tab bar, optional Undo, 3 s.
components.badge: Pink pill or dot, thin ink outline, white bold 11.

brand.$comment: App name not chosen yet; read it from here, never hard-code it.

folderTab.$comment: Right edge slants outward going down. Normalised path from the desktop card.
